# Pro Drain Cleaning Limited

> 24/7 drain cleaning, main sewer line unclogging, restaurant and commercial drain service, and emergency plumbing serving Winnipeg, Selkirk, St. Norbert, Manitoba, and every community within 100 km of Winnipeg, Canada.

Pro Drain Cleaning Limited is a locally owned drain and sewer specialist. A real technician answers the phone and WhatsApp 24 hours a day, 7 days a week — not an answering service. Every job is quoted with a flat price approved before work starts. Contact: +1 (204) 399-4413 (call or WhatsApp) or prodraincleaningcentre@gmail.com.

## Services

- [Drain Cleaning Winnipeg](https://prodraincleaning.ca/drain-cleaning-winnipeg): Kitchen, bathroom, tub, shower, toilet, floor, and laundry drain cleaning, plus main line clearing, using snaking, hydro jetting and camera inspection.
- [Main Sewer Line Unclogging Winnipeg](https://prodraincleaning.ca/main-sewer-line-unclogging-winnipeg): Tree root removal, hydro jetting for sewer lines, sewer camera inspection, sewer line locating, and sewer backup cleanup.
- [Restaurant & Commercial Drain Cleaning Winnipeg](https://prodraincleaning.ca/restaurant-commercial-drain-cleaning-winnipeg): Grease trap line cleaning, floor drain maintenance, commercial kitchen drains, washroom drains, storm drains, and preventive maintenance programs.
- [Plumbing Services Winnipeg](https://prodraincleaning.ca/plumbing-services-winnipeg): Faucet and toilet repair, garbage disposal repair, leak detection, pipe and water line repair, sump pump installation, backwater valve installation, drain installation, and frozen pipe thawing.
- [24/7 Emergency Drain & Plumbing Winnipeg](https://prodraincleaning.ca/emergency-drain-plumbing-winnipeg): Emergency drain cleaning, emergency sewer backup service, emergency clogged toilet service, and emergency flood response, any hour, every day of the year.
